Name: AutoEat Eidee Bridge
Author: dagarxji
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Bridge mod to allow restarting autocast after autoeat.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Lay out any steps users must follow to install your mod[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]* Bridges AutoEat and Eidee's Easy Fishing autocast.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]* Soft cap on fish/day via stopping this bridge (can still fish after cap).[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]* Progression system from level 0 -> 10 fishing. Each level allows 10% of total cap.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]* Total cap per day can be adjusted using Generic Mod Config Menu.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]* Also added trash deletion option.[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]* Level 10 fishing may yield "Angler's Seal[/color]" which will permanently remove the cap.
* Tracker to see how many fish caught / day + rate, etc.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Eidee's Easy Fishing[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]AutoEat[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://github.com/dagarxji/SDVMods/releases/tag/AutoEatEideeBridge/latest]Github Link[/url][/color]

Manifest.Name: Auto-Eat + Eidee Easy Fishing Bridge
Manifest.Description: Resumes Eidee Auto Recast after Auto-Eat, tracks fishing stats, and manages a level-scaled daily catch cap.
Manifest.Author: Local
